title: A VHS TAPE SOLD MILAN ON SHEVCHENKO. PRICE: ABOUT $24 MILLION
description:
Milan's scouts skipped the game. Their director ordered a recording instead.

5 November 1997, Camp Nou. Dynamo Kyiv won 4-0 at Barcelona and Shevchenko scored a hat-trick. Milan's scouts weren't there. Ariedo Braida had a VHS copy ordered from a newsroom, and that tape did the scouting.

Summer 1999: Milan paid about 45 billion lire, roughly 24 million dollars. The tape looked right. In 2003-04 he scored 24 goals in 32 Serie A games and won the Ballon d'Or.

Then came Chelsea in 2006. They paid 30.8 million pounds. He scored 22 goals in 77 games in all competitions. Be kind, rewind.
